title: Counting Unlabeled Chordal Graphs by Equivariant Evaporation
summary: We compute the number of unlabeled chordal graphs on $n$ vertices, both the total count (OEIS A048193) and the connected count (OEIS A048192), extending two sequences whose published values had remained at $n=15$. The method is a Polya-Burnside enumeration: the number of unlabeled graphs in a class closed under relabeling is the average over $S_n$ of the number of labeled graphs fixed by each permutation.
